statements.t: Top-line results for SLIM-1™, the first-in-human Phase 1 trial of NPM-139, Vivani's miniature, ultra-long-acting semaglutide implant under development for chronic weight management, are anticipated for announcement later this week

We look forward to sharing those results with shareholders, industry peers, and the broader community of physicians and patients seeking less frequent dosing and the promise of potential improvements in convenience, medication adherence, and tolerability associated with GLP-1 therapies on the market and in clinical-stage development."
While there are multiple GLP-1 injectable candidates targeting monthly or quarterly administration under development, none can offer reversibility comparable to our NanoPortal implants.

Release of top-line data for SLIM-1, the on-going Phase 1 study of low-dose NPM-139, Vivani’s miniature, ultra long-acting semaglutide implant under development for chronic weight management, are anticipated in November 2026.
